description: Given a list of integers s that may contain duplicates, return the list of its distinct values, each appearing exactly once, ordered by their first occurrence in s. Every element of the result must occur in s and every element of s must occur in the result. The list may be empty.
notes: VERINA's order condition Pairwise(idxOf result a < idxOf result b -> idxOf s a < idxOf s b) is stated in both languages as: for i < j, idxOf(s, result[i]) < idxOf(s, result[j]). The two are equivalent given the 'every element occurs exactly once' conjunct (then idxOf(result, result[i]) == i). The Dafny IdxOf is recursive with {:fuel 12} so the verifier can evaluate it on the test inputs.
